verdict.rationale: llamafile's own docs show a built-in local HTTP server: a `--server` mode with HTTP server and API options, a Web UI at localhost:8080, and "model, runtime, and server in one file". So a local API server for loaded GGUF models is documented, but nothing in the pack states that the API is OpenAI-compatible. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g., /v1/chat/completions), API usage docs, hands-on corroboration of client compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and server sandbox options.
llamafile is the model, runtime, and server in one file.
just open a browser window and connect to http://localhost:8080/
Supports GGUF models including Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi.
